links.outcome: Pathologist workload and ancillary tests with versus without AI collaboration
links.effect: Human-AI collaboration reduced diagnostic workload by 35%, avoided 105 ancillary tests, and detected micrometastases with 87.5% accuracy.
links.quote: Human-AI collaboration further reduced diagnostic workload by 35%, avoided 105 ancillary tests and enhanced detection of micrometastases with 87.5% accuracy.

links.outcome: Generalization of model performance across institutions, tumor types, and anatomical sites
links.effect: Robust generalization across 6 institutions, 14 tumor types, and 24 anatomical sites, including previously unseen sites and rare cancers.
links.quote: The model demonstrated robust generalization across 6 institutions, 14 tumor types, and 24 anatomical sites-including previously unseen sites and rare cancers.

screen.reason: The study prospective evaluated a pathology foundation model in a clinical cohort of over 3,000 patients, assessing the impact of human-AI collaboration on diagnostic workload and surgical decisions.

primary.practice: human-AI collaboration in intraoperative pathology workflow
